Interface IF_GameModel

All Known Implementing Classes:
Board
public interface IF_GameModel
Model's Interface for ModelViewController pattern.
Interface for the methods that the Controller calls directly on the Model in order to update the game status.

    • pickTile

      void pickTile(Player player, Tile tile) throws IOException
      Move - Pick Tile.
      This method updates the Model due to the move "Pick Tile" done from a Player.
      If the Tile is already occupied, nothing happens.
      Pre: player != null && tile != null
      Parameters:
      player - Player who has made the move.
      tile - Tile picked by the Player.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • pickCard

      boolean pickCard(Player player, CharacterCard card) throws IOException
      Move - Pick Card (Character Card).
      This method updates the Model due to the move "Pick Card" done from a Player, in particular this method works with Character Cards.
      If the Card is not displayed on the Board, nothing happens.
      Pre: player != null && card != null
      Parameters:
      player - Player who has made the move.
      card - Card picked by the Player.
      Returns:
      True if the Move ended successfully, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • pickCard

      boolean pickCard(Player player, BuildingCard card) throws IOException
      Move - Pick Card (Building Card).
      This method updates the Model due to the move "Pick Card" done from a Player, in particular this method works with Building Cards.
      If the Card is not displayed on the Board, nothing happens.
      Pre: player != null && card != null
      Parameters:
      player - Player who has made the move.
      card - Card picked by the Player.
      Returns:
      True if the Move ended successfully, false otherwise.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.

    • prepare

      void prepare() throws IOException
      Load the Game.
      This method works as a pre-game loader, by loading the various components of the Game (Tiles & Cards) adn preparing the various decks and rows.
      Throws:
      IOException - The resources cannot be load correctly.

    • start

      void start()
      Setup and start the Game.
      This method defines the first Game status, by drawing the first rows and starting the first Era of the Game.

    • nextRound

      void nextRound() throws IOException
      Start a new Round.
      This method starts a new Round, by updating the Players' order and all the rows.
      It also checks if a new Era has started.
      Throws:
      IOException - The connection cannot be established correctly.
